data.explanation: This is a welcome letter confirming your new gym membership contract. It starts on 1 January 2027 with a minimum term (Erstlaufzeit) of 12 months; afterwards it continues indefinitely and can be cancelled monthly. The app will show you the exact cancellation window one month before the end of the first term, so you don't need to do anything now unless you decide to cancel later. You may train free of charge until the membership start date. The monthly fee of €34.00 will be collected regularly.
